node.label: Nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
node.definition: An acute condition characterized by sudden visual loss (usually discovered in the morning), optic disc edema at onset, optic disc-related visual field defects. Nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy can be associated with flame hemorrhages on the swollen disk or nearby neuroretinal layer, and sometimes with nearby cotton-wool exudates.
